items.question: What is the largest organ in the human body?
items.explanation: The skin is the body's largest organ, protecting us from the outside world.

items.question: Which country is home to the Great Barrier Reef?
items.explanation: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, located off the coast of Queensland, Australia.

items.question: What planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
items.explanation: Mars gets its reddish hue from iron oxide, commonly known as rust, on its surface.

items.question: Which classic film features the line, 'Here's looking at you, kid'?
items.explanation: This iconic line is spoken by Humphrey Bogart's character, Rick Blaine, in the romantic drama 'Casablanca'.

items.question: Mount Everest is located in which mountain range?
items.explanation: Mount Everest, the world's highest peak, is part of the Himalayan mountain range between Nepal and China.

items.question: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?
items.explanation: The fall of the Berlin Wall on November 9, 1989, marked a pivotal moment in world history, leading to German reunification.

items.question: Who composed the music for the 'Star Wars' film series?
items.explanation: John Williams created the iconic scores for the 'Star Wars' saga and many other famous films.

items.question: How many days are in a leap year?
items.explanation: A leap year occurs every four years, adding an extra day (February 29th) to keep our calendar aligned with Earth's orbit.

items.question: Which country has the most time zones?
items.explanation: France has twelve zones counting its territories.
